datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Mauritania to classify geographic areas into IPC acute food insecurity phases. Survey data were spatially integrated and classified according to IPC methodology to produce geographic datasets representing food insecurity outcomes at the sub-national level.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity outcomes driven by underlying hazards including drought and economic shocks.
